title: Synthetic Streamly Challenge — validate empirical core blind (10 regimes)

result.headline: causal 7/8 vs naive 6/8 directional; advantage = the sign-flip case only; 3/10 wrong ALL at high confidence (calibration gap)

notes: codex wedged->self-blind gen; KEY FINDING: overlap-confidence misses unobserved-confounding+null errors (all 3 errors high-conf). Need negative-control/sensitivity guards. Next: T2 calibrated abstention jumps priority.

title: Negative-control outcome as a confounding guard (blind, 10 regimes)

result.headline: negative control CATCHES unobserved confounding overlap missed (P1), but pre-registered 0.02 band false-alarms on benign observed-confounding residual incl the sign-flip win (P2 fail) -> NULL by strict rule

notes: STRONG sub-finding: P1 confirmed — neg-control reveals hidden confounding (nc +0.30/+0.10) vs benign observed residual (0.02-0.04). Single fixed absolute band cannot separate them. Next (iter2, FRESH data): SE/significance-based trip + practical floor so it spares observed-confounding wins. Do NOT retune on this data.

title: Negative-control guard, magnitude floor 0.05 (HELD-OUT fresh data)
baseline: overlap-only (iter0) missed 3/3; iter1 floor=0.02 false-alarmed 3 wins

result.residual_error: true_null false-positive (P3 honest limit, neg-control cannot catch)
result.separation: trips at nc 0.097/0.286; all spared cases nc<=0.041; floor 0.05 in the gap
result.headline: HELD-OUT replication: neg-control + 0.05 floor catches BOTH hidden-confounding errors with ZERO false alarms incl sign-flip win

notes: FIRST LEAD. Floor 0.05 chosen on iter1 dev gap, validated on fresh v3 seed -> not p-hacked. Router implication: empirical estimate is trusted only if a valid negative-control outcome shows |effect|<0.05; else abstain->LLM. Open: (a) needs REAL microdata replication; (b) true-null residual still uncaught -> separate guard; (c) router must identify WHICH metric is a valid negative control (LLM/domain job).

title: Negative-control guard on REAL Hillstrom RCT + adversarial sweep

result.headline: neg-control guard REPLICATES on real RCT: 100% specificity, 75% sensitivity; 0.05 floor transferred synthetic->real; weak NC (newbie) silently misses bias

notes: Strongest campaign result so far. NOT PROMOTED: confounding is INJECTED not natural, n=1 real dataset. KEY honest finding: guard power depends on a STRONGLY-coupled negative control; weak NC (newbie) under-trips -> picking the NC is an LLM/domain job. Specificity (no false abstain on clean RCT) is the fully-real, rock-solid half.

title: Multi-NC CONSENSUS guard (max over several controls), held-out self-blind
baseline: single weak negative control (iter3 newbie-style under-trips)

result.P1_specificity: 4/4 PASS (max residual <=0.031, no false alarm from 3 NCs)
result.headline: consensus(max over NCs) recovers the unobserved-with-proxy cases a weak single control misses, WITHOUT losing specificity; fixes iter3 newbie failure
result.real_data_corroboration: iter3 Hillstrom sweep: max over 4 NCs => recency~0.6 trips (100% sens) + clean max~0.015 (100% spec)

notes: Synthetic ceiling MECH-ONLY but tagged LEAD (held-out + corroborated by iter3 real sweep). Pre-registered false-alarm risk of MAX-over-many did NOT materialize here (specificity held). Router rule update: use a SET of candidate negative controls, trip on consensus(max). Still LLM/domain job to nominate them.

title: True-null guard: trust sign only if main effect exceeds the bias the control reveals
baseline: old guard (null-band sign) called all true-nulls a real effect

result.headline: ratio rule |main|>1.5x|nc_residual| converts confident-wrong true-null calls into honest abstentions; clear effects still trusted; sub-bias real effects deferred to LLM

notes: Closes the last open gap. Honest cost: a real effect SMALLER than the confounding bias is unidentifiable -> deferred to LLM (correct fallback, not error). Note: recalibrated confounder to mostly-linear (sub-floor residuals) BEFORE commit/unseal so the ratio rule, not the floor, was tested. Folded ratio into causal_estimator negative_control_guard(ratio=1.5). Guard now complete: floor + consensus + ratio.

title: GUARD FAILS PROMOTION on canonical naturally-confounded real data (LaLonde NSW)
baseline: experimental ATE +$1794 (true positive); synthetic guard LEADs

result.P1_specificity_RCT: FAIL: guard FALSE-TRIPS on clean experimental NSW (adjusted re74 placebo -0.074>floor, small-n T-learner noise)
result.P2_detection_DECISIVE: FAIL (load-bearing): on PSID(-$15k naive, wrong sign) & CPS(-$8.5k) the guard does NOT trip -> false-confident on MASSIVE real hidden confounding -> would SHIP wrong-sign answer
result.P3_COCA: COCA stays negative on B/C (lean held: does not recover experimental + sign)
result.mechanism: re75 in adjustment set is near-collinear with NC re74; adjusting NC on its twin deflates the placebo residual (-$17k raw -> -$406 adjusted) while NOT cleaning re78 (4yr out). Synth->real transfer FAILED; a collinearity failure mode synthetic never exercised
result.headline: The negative-control guard (campaign first validated win, 4 synthetic LEADs) FAILS on the canonical real confounded benchmark. RAW re74 placebo would have detected it perfectly (~0 RCT, huge confounded) but ADJUSTING the NC on a collinear proxy breaks detection. Reveals a fundamental adjust-vs-raw tension.

notes: MAJOR honest negative. Validates adversary critiques (c) synthetic-circular + (e) nothing-transfers. Downgrades campaign confidence: synthetic LEADs were partly artifacts of DGPs lacking NC-collinear covariates. Founder-readout needs this caveat. Candidate fix = NC-collinearity-aware covariate selection or proximal/double-NC; promotion still open.

title: NC-collinearity-aware adjustment restores guard detection on LaLonde
baseline: broken guard (lalonde-promotion NULL: under-trips on -$15k/-$8.5k confounding)

result.P1_detection_restored: PASS: re75 removed from NC adjustment -> NC residual B -0.979, C -1.126 (both >> 0.05 floor) -> guard TRIPS+abstains on both observational conditions (was -0.026/-0.031, no-trip)
result.P2_specificity: PASS: experimental A residual -0.034 < floor -> no false-trip; the prior -0.074 small-n false-trip also CLEARED (it was partly re75 collinearity)
result.mechanism_confirmed: raw placebo upper bound A -0.002 / B -1.109 / C -1.233; re75-removed residuals sit just inside -> baseline covariates barely clean the placebo once the collinear twin is gone
result.headline: The promotion-test failure WAS the NC-collinearity mechanism. Principled rule (do NOT adjust a negative control on a covariate near-collinear with it) restores detection on LaLonde with intact specificity. CANDIDATE FIX / LEAD direction, NOT promotion.

notes: Validated ONLY on LaLonde (n=1 benchmark). Raises NC sensitivity globally -> risk of false-positives where NC legitimately correlates with a benign covariate (the adjust-vs-raw tension persists). Promotion needs: synthetic re-validation WITH NC-collinear covariates in the DGP + the ~6 other real RCTs + IHDP/ACIC. Concrete new NC-nomination rule: avoid adjustment-set collinearity.

title: Re-validate LaLonde covariate-drop fix on synthetic-with-collinearity + 4 real RCTs
summary: Decisive specificity test (Part A P3) FAILS: FIXED guard false-trips 0.517 overall / 1.000 at collin .95 on benign true-null cells (vs OLD 0.011). Part B P5 corroborates: 1/4 false-trip on real Orange-Belgium RCT. Fix restores detection (P2 PASS, P4 sign-recovery 3/3) but trades too much specificity. Covariate-drop reverts to RAW where it fires, and RAW false-alarms on benign observed-selection. Route to proximal/double-NC (MGT 2018). Carries: scale-aware floor; NC-nomination anti-collinearity is a selection rule not a fix. data_type=synthetic+real mix.
